objectives:
“The objective of this course is intended to develop student‘s intuition in operation management and serve as a fundation for students pursuing more advance topics in this field, such supply chain management.
Topics includes Invnetory Control, MRP, JIT, and more.“
content:
“Introduction
EOQ model and its variants
Dynamic Lot Sizing
Statistical Reorder Point Models: Newsvendor Model
Statistical Reorder Point Models: Base Stock Model
Statistical Reorder Point Models: (Q,r) Model
Statistical Reorder Point Models: (Q,r) Model
Myopic Approach for Multiple Period Problems
Basic Factory Dynamics
Variability Basics
Corrupting Influence of Variability
Corrupting Influence of Variability
Push and Pull Production Systems
Push and Pull Production Systems
Shop Floor Control
Aggregate Planning“
books: “W.J. Hopp and M.L. Spearman. Factory Physics, 3rd edition. 2008. McGraw-Hill.“
